name: Content translation access user
description: Submodule of Content translation access: adds a per-user 'field_access_languages' field and a LanguageProvider plugin that assigns those languages to the user.
project_description: Submodule of Content Translation Access. Adds an entity-reference field 'field_access_languages' to the user entity (referencing configurable_language, unlimited cardinality) and a 'user_language_provider' LanguageProvider plugin that returns the languages selected on that field as the current user's assigned translation languages.
